description: Otherwise bounded, timeout-guarded module whose unmount() passes a fresh this.onQuote.bind(this) to feed.off, so the listener mount() registered is never removed: every mount/unmount cycle leaks a listener that keeps the widget alive

hard.note: off() looks symmetric with on(), but each bind() returns a new function, so the removal matches nothing; the cache is bounded and the fetch has a timeout

_calibration.note: Window modeled on perf-nplus1-loop narrowed to one defect. Leak verified by execution on Node: EventEmitter on('quote', w.onTick.bind(w)) then off('quote', w.onTick.bind(w)) leaves listenerCount 1.
